name: Vaal Arcanist's Infuser
description:
Improves the quality of a wand, staff or sceptre,
exceeding maximum quality by up to 10% with a chance of Corrupting it
directions: Right click this item then left click a wand, staff or sceptre to apply it. Can only be used on items at or above maximum quality.
consoleDirections: X to use, then A on a wand, staff or sceptre to apply it. Can only be used on items at or above maximum quality.
